parent_scheme.name: sangok_c04_two_gardens
parent_scheme.secondary_language: 열린 주민 정원과 조용한 안쪽 정원
parent_scheme.formal_principle: 넓게 열린 주민 정원과 조용한 내부 정원을 실제 방이 들어갈 중간 몸으로 구분하고 2층의 남북 실들로 연결한다.
parent_scheme.dominant_gesture: 하나의 낮은 청사 안에 공공성과 크기가 다른 두 정원
parent_scheme.reference_basis: 등록된 산곡동 공공1 필지와 comp03 실제 평단면 비평에 근거한 공간 가설. 확정 법정 프로그램이나 실별 면적표가 아님.

ops.why: A public reception-and-meeting hypothesis and quieter daily work need different outdoor addresses. Two full storeys at 3.9 metres keep usable rooms around both gardens; no extra roof folds obscure this relation.

A broad east-facing public garden is separated from a quiet west garden by a room-deep middle body. North and south rooms connect the two without forcing visitors through private work rooms. The public opening is a broad mouth, not the previous narrow keyhole. All rooms begin at ground; this is a spatial mass, not a verified program or structural design.

design_argument_ko.title: 열린 주민 정원과 조용한 안쪽 정원
design_argument_ko.spatial_strategy: 동쪽의 넓게 열린 공공 정원과 서쪽의 닫힌 작은 정원을 두고, 그 사이에 공용방이 들어갈 깊이의 몸을 둔다. 전체는 높이 7.8m, 자체 층고 3.9m의 2층 구상이다. 남북 실들이 두 정원 주변을 이어 업무와 주민 활동에 다른 외부 주소를 준다.
design_argument_ko.tradeoff: 중간 몸의 가설 벽체 차감 깊이는 약 5.08m여서 독립 복도와 방을 동시에 넣으면 좁아질 수 있다. 접수·라운지처럼 통과 가능한 공용방으로 쓸지 후속 평면에서 결정해야 하며, 안쪽 정원의 채광·프라이버시도 미확인이다.

scheme.name: sangok_c04_develop_perforated_base
scheme.secondary_language: Perforated base beneath a continuous upper body
scheme.formal_principle: Lift a narrow transverse strip of the underside to form a covered ground passage through the central body and rear wall. The continuous upper volume frames the two carved courts while the retained north and south masses remain grounded.
scheme.dominant_gesture: Perforated base beneath a continuous upper body
scheme.reference_basis: Exact scored comp04 parent; architectural massing development. Public-office and meeting uses remain hypotheses.

ops.why: Retain the parent two-storey, 7.8 m maximum envelope and 3.9 m authored storey height.

Lift a narrow transverse strip of the underside to form a covered ground passage through the central body and rear wall. The continuous upper volume frames the two carved courts while the retained north and south masses remain grounded.

design_argument_ko.title: Perforated base beneath a continuous upper body
design_argument_ko.spatial_strategy: Lift a narrow transverse strip of the underside to form a covered ground passage through the central body and rear wall. The continuous upper volume frames the two carved courts while the retained north and south masses remain grounded.
design_argument_ko.tradeoff: The passage is a modeled void, not a verified door, circulation route or engineered transfer structure. Its upper bridge needs structural development.

design_argument_ko.tradeoff: Both courts give area to the deeper common body. The upper outer rooms have a lower envelope; room partitions and headroom below structural members are not yet designed.

scheme.name: sangok_c04_develop_rear_opening
scheme.secondary_language: Narrow rear opening between retained room masses
scheme.formal_principle: Cut a narrow full-height opening through the rear enclosing wall, giving the smaller court a direct rear address toward the mapped river-side context. The two room masses frame this slot while the broad opposite recess remains the primary public address.
scheme.dominant_gesture: Narrow rear opening between retained room masses
scheme.reference_basis: Exact scored comp04 parent; architectural massing development. Public-office and meeting uses remain hypotheses.

ops.why: Retain the parent two-storey, 7.8 m maximum envelope and 3.9 m authored storey height.

Cut a narrow full-height opening through the rear enclosing wall, giving the smaller court a direct rear address toward the mapped river-side context. The two room masses frame this slot while the broad opposite recess remains the primary public address.

design_argument_ko.title: Narrow rear opening between retained room masses
design_argument_ko.spatial_strategy: Cut a narrow full-height opening through the rear enclosing wall, giving the smaller court a direct rear address toward the mapped river-side context. The two room masses frame this slot while the broad opposite recess remains the primary public address.
design_argument_ko.tradeoff: The quiet court becomes a sheltered pocket rather than a fully enclosed void. The mapped river-side relation does not establish a public access right or an existing pedestrian connection.

design_argument_ko.title: Recessed entry volume on the open court

design_argument_ko.tradeoff: The recess consumes part of the southern room depth. It provides an architectural threshold, but night-time separation, doors, stairs and accessible routes remain unverified.
